Name: Joses, Brother of Jesus
Summary: Joses was one of the brothers of Jesus named by the people of Nazareth, alongside James, Simon, and Judas. The Gospels record nothing further of him by name.
KeyStory: The people of Nazareth named Joses among Jesus' brothers and stumbled that the carpenter's family held no prophet.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; James, Brother of Jesus; Mary, Mother of Jesus
LifeLesson: Familiarity can blind us to glory. Nazareth knew Jesus' brothers and missed its Saviour.
